item.title: 2026 NFL Draft Scouting Assistant
item.description: This tool lets you sort prospects by PFF grade, snaps and WAA, all while viewing Trevor Sikkema’s expert analysis for the top players. Build your own fully customizable draft board that saves automatically in your browser: add scouting notes, reorder rankings anytime, download your full board and even share a top-10 image — all with direct links to player profiles for deeper evaluation.
